limitations: Reviewed precious-metal anode-slime market: preserve each inspected one-kilogram positive product reference and its original refinery supplier shares, using the complete UVEK Swedish precious-metals-in-anode-slime refinery process as a same-function, same-unit screening proxy for each supplier. Both source and target describe the same multi-output secondary-copper electrolytic-refining boundary and precious-metal coproduct; neither is incoming electronics scrap, bulk copper, pure gold or final refined precious metal. No source market has freight, operating inputs or direct emissions. Every source refinery is nonempty; this is not an empty allocation stock or zero-burden recovery handoff. The complete UVEK process includes its own operating inputs, emissions and allocation; do not add the source refinery inventory or apply the roughly 0.932 source/native common-emission ratio as a conversion factor. Allocation, vintage, technology, water definitions, supply mix and LCIA equivalence are not established. Swedish refining approximates RoW refining; original regional supply shares are retained as separate target inputs but do not restore RoW electricity or emissions. Source market edges are deterministic and have no formulas or parameters; refinery-internal uncertainty, parameters and correlations are represented by the complete target proxy, not reconstructed from the source. Preserve signed caller quantities, including negative product credits, caller uncertainty/formulas/metadata, foreground suppliers, production and separate emissions. No waste-service sign flip, normalization, additional recovery credit or inferred reverse correspondence is approved. Only the eleven inspected exact cut-off market profiles are approved; consequential, missing and other patch profiles require an independent review.
